_comment: Source catalogue for Six Flags America. Wire datasets as they are surveyed; fetch official listings with npm run venues:research -- six-flags-america --fetch. External adapters sync via npm run venues:sync-sources -- six-flags-america. Offline scaffolds omit token-gated adapters; declare mapillary/a11y/ORS when bounds exist.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, paths, buildings, and the venue boundary.
Height requirements and attraction names for the current season.

adapters.ropedrop: RopeDrop open data covers Disney/Universal parks only — not applicable here.

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. LLM park-map search is required to locate guest-map image/PDF assets for tracing. Never invents coordinates.
